subject: EdgeOps: request to move unused webinar promo credits to EdgeOps Summit
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: EdgeOps request: rollover of unused webinar credits into EdgeOps Summit

Hi team,

EdgeOps (Sarah Lin, partners@edgeops.co) reached out this morning asking whether we can reassign a block of unused webinar promo credits from a canceled regional workshop to their upcoming EdgeOps Summit (virtual + regional hubs). They sent the attached usage export (edgeops_promo_usage.csv) and a short note about expected attendees and partner tiers.

Quick summary:
- Original allocation: 10,000 trial tokens for the cancelled March workshop
- Used so far: ~1,120 tokens
- Remaining: ~8,880 tokens
- EdgeOps asks to: 1) move remaining promo codes to a dedicated Summit pool, 2) extend validity from 30 -> 90 days, 3) allow partner-branded landing page to redeem codes (they'll self-serve redemption).

Notes / questions for approvals:
- Does this sit within our standard credits policy for partner rollovers? (I recall a 6-month cap, but exceptions allowed for event reallocation.)
- Any guardrails we want on per-user redemption or coupon stacking?
- Need a small contract amendment / DocuSign to reflect extended validity and branded landing page. Marcus, can legal weigh in on the redline? I attached a draft amendment I prepared (draft-amendment-redline.pdf) to speed the loop if this gets approved.

EdgeOps is a warm partner; they run a developer-targeted summit (expected 1.2k signups) and have resale channels. If we approve, they'd like the codes available by Apr 5 to include in early-bird comms.

Happy to sync on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Partner Growth | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeOps request: rollover of unused webinar credits into EdgeOps Summit

Thanks for the summary, Jas — good context. Quick thoughts:

- I'm comfortable with a rollover of unused promo tokens to a partner event in this case, provided we cap the transferred amount to remaining unused tokens and include a 90-day expiry.
- Recommend per-account redemption limit: 5,000 tokens max per company (prevents a single org from consuming all).
- No stacking allowed with other Redwood promotional offers (explicit clause in amendment).
- Marcus: please review the attached redline and flag any legal/finance objections. If legal signs off, I can approve from Growth side and route for DocuSign.

If everyone agrees, I'll confirm to EdgeOps that we can move up to 8,880 tokens, subject to an amendment and standard SOW addendum.

Marissa
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
